data.name: Beast Reality
data.detailed_description:
Arena Based Gameplay

Arena Mode features three rounds where victory comes from knocking opponents off the stage or dealing 200% damage. Before each round, players share 300 credits to buy from 20 unique ability cards—ranging from buffs to powerful one-time ultimates—adding strategy and variety to every match.

Arena Campaign Mode

Arena Campaign Mode lets up to 4 players team up against a series of unique, escalating boss battles. Between fights, you’ll upgrade abilities and stats in the shop, making teamwork and strategy essential to surviving tougher challenges.

Story

In the distant future, Earth has fallen under the control of a powerful alien race known as the Drox, who have absorbed our planet into the ranks of their vast galactic empire. With humanity absent, the Drox have repurposed Earth’s surviving animals as warriors in their brutal entertainment spectacle—the Galactic Gladiator League.

Now, these creatures must fight for survival in colossal alien colosseums scattered across the stars. Battle to the death by knocking opponents off the stage in intense 1v1 or 2v2 matchups, or team up with up to three friends to take down towering, nightmarish alien bosses. The arena awaits—only the strongest will endure.
